 Beauty of Joseon takes over How Matcha! cafés for week-long pop-up 
 Sophie Smith 26 October 2026 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Linkedin 
 WhatsApp 
 Beauty of Joseon has partnered with London matcha café How Matcha! on a week-long takeover of its Marylebone and Notting Hill sites, running from today until 1 November. 
 The Korean skincare brand’s collaboration introduces a limited-edition menu of drinks inspired by its products, alongside giveaways, complimentary gifts and exclusive merchandise.
 An online competition offers customers the chance to attend a Beauty of Joseon workshop at the Notting Hill café on 28 October. The same location will host a Halloween celebration on 31 October, featuring a live DJ, exclusive drinks and prizes to close the week.
 How Matcha! has also been promoting the partnership through a street-poster campaign featuring the line “Drink your skincare”. Customers who spot a poster can tear off a ticket and redeem it at the bar for a free matcha.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by How Matcha | All Day Matcha Bar (@howmatchaofficial) 
 The activation follows the brand’s interactive pop-up at Westfield Stratford City over the Easter Bank Holiday weekend. In July, its Relief Sun Rice + Probiotics SPF50 topped Lookfantastic’s summer travel minis ranking .
 The tie-up adds to a growing number of beauty and drinks collaborations in London this year. Anua returned to EL&N London in May with a matcha drink promoting its suncream. Laneige partnered with Atis on a smoothie inspired by its latest lip launch, while Cult Beauty teamed up with Smoov for a summer wellness pop-up.
 In August, Monday Haircare hosted a two-day pop-up with Caffè Crema , and Lookfantastic launched a smoothie in collaboration with Meet At Joey’s .
